reason: We'd probably go once or twice a month, so an unlimited membership isn't worth it with daycare costs up this year. I might try a drop-in or hear about it in my moms group, but I wouldn't commit to a monthly fee.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a $59 membership. At $12 a visit plus a drink it only pays off if we go 5 times or more, and money is tight.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper tier or a punch card (like 4 visits for around $35) that doesn't expire, or a group rate for my moms group meetups.
